messages:
Riya (Growth): Quick creative ask for the "Serve Better" webinar next Tue — we need a small asset bundle for paid social and sales enablement. Core theme = inference economics (latency vs cost). Need: 1) animated hero gif (1200x628, loop <3s) with a single KPI reveal, light/dark variants 2) static 1-pager (printable A4 + web PDF) with benchmark snapshot + CTA + UTM table 3) three social tiles (1080x1080) each with A/B copy for testing 4) a slide-ready PNG for SDRs (1920x1080) 5) export-ready copy table for localization (EN/FR/DE) + alt-texts. Deadline: Fri EOD PT.
Marco (PM): Thanks Riya. Priorities are hero gif > 1-pager > social tiles > SDR slide. Also: we need the assets to include a short handoff sheet with: approved exports, filenames, Figma link, copy table, UTMs, and legal notes.
Sofia (Design): Ok noted. Animation question: do you want a data-driven reveal (animated sparkline growing) or a simple morph (bar -> percent delta)? Data-driven looks nicer but needs canonical CSV.
Marco (PM): Use simple sparkline + callout delta bars. I'll upload canonical CSV now. Keep timing tight: reveal timing should emphasize the cost delta at 1.8s.
Sofia (Design): Cool. I'll make two motion concepts: "subtle motion" (fade + sparkline) and "punchy" (bar flip + number pop). Will mock as MP4 in Figma prototype and export GIF optimized for 3s.
Tom (Legal): Heads up — trademark usage for partner logos on the 1-pager needs sign-off. Also legal wants the logo lockup spacing and the fallback privacy blurb on the download page. Pass me the PDF draft before localization.
Riya (Growth): Noted Tom. Also add UTM table: campaign=serve-better-2026, source=paid_social|email|partner, medium=paid|email|referral, content=heroA|heroB etc. Add examples in the handoff sheet.
Sofia (Design): Export naming preference? I suggest `launch/webinar/2026-servebetter/<asset>-<variant>-<size>-v1.<ext>` e.g. `launch/webinar/2026-servebetter/hero-punchy-1200x628-v1.gif`.
Marco (PM): That naming works. Also include alt-text drafts (one short sentence) and a 1-line descriptive caption for social posts.
assets-bot: Figma file created: https://www.figma.com/file/efgh5678/serve-better-webinar-assets 1: access set to "anyone with link" (view).
Sofia (Design): Notes on accessibility: use colorblind-safe palette for charts (avoid red/green pairs), maintain 4.5:1 contrast for body copy, 3:1 for large headings. Minimum 14px at 1080x1080. Will run Lighthouse color checks.
Marco (PM): Localization: plan for +25% text expansion for DE, and make separate Figma pages per locale with editable text layers. Also provide CSV with keys for copy and alt-text.
Riya (Growth): For paid social variants: Please produce two copy variants per tile: Variant A = technical ("Latency optimized inference at 1/3 the cost"), Variant B = benefit-led ("Ship LLM features faster, pay less per token"). Use short CTAs: "Register" / "Watch live".
Sofia (Design): Will craft 3 tile layouts: data-callout, hero-shot (with product screenshot), and narrative-focus (quote + stat). Each with A/B copy layers.
Tom (Legal): Also include legal asset metadata: "copyright 2026 Redwood Inference. All rights reserved." plus trademark list. If partner logos are used, include a "logos-by-permission" file.
Sofia (Design): Will attach a one-page "design spec" sheet in the Figma file listing export presets, padding, safe-zone for logo, typography (Inter var), and a plain-text copy table for translators.
Marco (PM): For SDR slide PNG, include a small how-to for lead routing: link for the registration form, note which utm values map to which lead source in the CRM. 
Riya (Growth): Lead routing details: we want `utm_campaign=serve-better-2026`, utm_source lists we discussed; map utm_source=paid_social to "Paid Ads" lead queue, utm_source=email to "Nurture" queue. Add a note on redirection: post-register redirect to /thanks?src=campaign.
Sofia (Design): Timeline: 1) Motion frames + static comps by Wed 10am PT 2) First GIF/pass + 1-pager draft by Thu noon PT 3) Final export + localization-ready files by Fri EOD PT.
Marco (PM): I'll review copy after first pass. Tom please flag any legal blockers by Thu EOD so localization isn't delayed.
Tom (Legal): Will do. Please add me to the Figma comment list.
Riya (Growth): Great team. Please @marketing channel when hero GIF is ready so paid ops can queue promos. Also leave a plain-text short caption for each social tile for platforms (X/LinkedIn).
Sofia (Design): Will do. :sparkles:
